title: Databases, Tables, and Schemas
description: Understand the structure of a SQL Server database. Learn how to create databases, tables, and schemas, and how they relate to each other.
whatYouLearn: How databases, tables, rows, and columns fit together in a relational model
The role of schemas in organizing database objects
How to create a new database and a new table with columns and data types
How to inspect existing database objects using system views
The difference between system databases and user databases
